en-US.name: Blender Skills

en-US.description: Pinned at 904f095d8f36a6e72adaebb08d07f884a074743d. Root LICENSE is MIT. The 94 skills are duplicated under .claude/skills and .cursor/skills; collection discovery keeps the .claude/skills paths and skips the duplicate IDs. This is not a runtime acceptance of Blender or MCP.

requirements.value: Requires a local Blender installation supported by the upstream MCP workflow. The skills do not bundle Blender.
Requires a separately configured Blender MCP server matching the repo's .mcp.json; MCP and Blender follow their own terms.
Blender and MCP actions can modify scene files and run local tools. Confirm the target project and permissions before execution; stop if Blender or MCP is unavailable.
